title: AuthorizeOfflinePassResponse
description: Server response to an AuthorizeOfflinePassRequest, granting or denying the offline pass authorization.

status.description: Result of the offline pass authorization.

sessionId.description: Assigned session identifier. Present when status is Accepted.

durationSeconds.description: Authorized service duration in seconds. Present when status is Accepted.

creditsAuthorized.description: Number of credits authorized for this session. Present when status is Accepted.

reason.description: Human-readable description of the refusal, for logs and operators, and not for programmatic matching: the code of the refusal is errorCode, and its registry name errorText (spec/profiles/offline/authorize-offline-pass.md §4). Present when status is Rejected.

errorCode.description: The registry code of the refusal: the code of the failed authorize-time check, or 6001 SERVER_INTERNAL_ERROR (spec/profiles/offline/authorize-offline-pass.md §4, §7). A server conforming to this revision carries it, with errorText, on every refusal, and the station relays both to the app in the BLE AuthResponse. Additive: a station accepts it before any server sends it (VERSIONING.md, 'Adding a REQUIRED field, and which side moves first').

errorText.description: The registry name of errorCode, in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (spec/07-errors.md §1.3).

details.description: Per-occurrence context of the refusal (spec/07-errors.md §1.3). Required with 4002 OFFLINE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, whose registry entry branches on its constraint: the pass field whose limit refused the presentation - maxUses or maxTotalCredits (spec/profiles/offline/authorize-offline-pass.md §4).
